heading_fil: Isang pagbabago, may may-ari at sukatan
heading_en: One change, an owner and a measure
display_fil: Trial: check ng approved handout bago printing. Elena: checklist. Midwife: version confirmation. Pagkaraan ng dalawang linggo: maling printout, session count at delays. Talakayin at baguhin kung bumaba ang kalidad.
display_en: Trial: check the approved handout before printing. Elena owns the checklist; the midwife confirms the version. After two weeks, review incorrect printouts, session counts and delays. Revise if quality suffers.

display_fil: Halimbawa: reprints 20/100 noon → 5/100 ngayon. Bawas na 15 bawat 100 pahina, mula 20% tungong 5%. Suriin kung magkatulad ang session at tama pa rin ang materyal. Walang patient names na kailangan.
display_en: Example: reprints 20/100 before → 5/100 after. A reduction of 15 per 100 pages, from 20% to 5%. Check comparable sessions and correct materials. No patient names are needed.

display_fil: “Dalawang bersyon sa drawer ang sanhi ng reprinting.” Ibigay ang mungkahi, owner at review date. Itanong ang hadlang gaya ng walang internet; maaaring kailangan ang controlled paper master.
display_en: “Two versions in the drawer cause reprinting.” Explain the proposal, owner and review date. Ask about barriers such as no internet; a controlled paper master may be needed.

display_fil: Limang session noon, sampu ngayon: maaaring tumaas ang total kahit bumuti ang proseso. Ihambing ang reprints bawat session o bawat 100 pahina, kasama ang complaints at delays.
display_en: Five sessions before, ten now: totals can rise even when the process improves. Compare reprints per session or per 100 pages, alongside complaints and delays.

heading_en: Keep the routine when people change
display_fil: Kapag wala si Elena, dapat magamit pa rin ang kit. Iwan ang maikling routine, ituro sa kapalit at tukuyin ang tatanggap ng stock-gap reports. Sa review, alisin ang walang silbing hakbang at panatilihin ang safeguards.
display_en: When Elena is absent, the kit must still work. Leave a short routine, orient the next person and name the stock-gap reporting contact. Remove unhelpful steps during review while preserving safeguards.

display_fil: Trial card: owner, baseline, kalidad, review date. 20/100 → 5/100. Ihambing ang parehong workload at tiyaking tama pa rin ang serbisyo.
display_en: Trial card: owner, baseline, quality, review date. 20/100 → 5/100. Compare like workloads and check that service remains correct.

display_fil: Ang mas mababang konsumo ay tagumpay lamang kung naibibigay pa rin ang tama at ligtas na serbisyo.
display_en: Lower consumption is a success only when correct, safe service is still delivered.

check.prompt_fil: Kalahati ang nabawas sa papel dahil kalahati rin ang nakanselang sessions. Ano ang masasabi?
check.prompt_en: Paper use halved because half the sessions were canceled. What can be concluded?

options.fil: Hindi pa patunay ng improvement; ihambing ang gamit bawat session at naibigay na serbisyo.
options.en: This does not yet show improvement; compare use per session and services delivered.

options.fil: Tagumpay na dahil mas mababa ang bill.
options.en: It is a success because the bill is lower.

options.fil: Wala nang kailangang review dahil nabawasan ang papel.
options.en: No review is needed because less paper was used.

check.feedback_fil: Ang unang sagot ay isinasaalang-alang ang workload at kalidad. Ang kabuuang bill o papel lamang ay maaaring bumaba dahil nawala ang serbisyo, hindi dahil bumuti ang proseso.
check.feedback_en: The first response accounts for workload and quality. Total bills or paper can fall because service was lost, not because the process improved.
